en.summary: Mixed commit whose primary DUT fix is preserving the correct request context across shared-memory bank-conflict replay; it also removes a harmful unmasked MSHR SRAM initialization write.
why_it_counts: The shared-memory changes correct replay semantics after a bank-conflicted access is split across multiple cycles.
The patch ensures replayed accesses keep the original request type and address context instead of reusing live front-end signals.
The same commit also removes an unmasked MSHR data SRAM write that was interfering with masked updates, which is another real DUT correctness fix.
disqualifiers: The commit is mixed: it also contains an assert-format fix and parameter changes that are not part of the primary bug mechanism.
evidence: ShareMem.scala changes coreReq_st1 capture from io.coreReq.ready to io.coreReq.fire, so replayed context is latched only for requests that were actually accepted.
BankConflictArbiter.scala exports bankConflict_isWrite, and ShareMem.scala uses it to distinguish replayed reads from replayed writes.
ShareMem.scala changes SRAM read valid and set-index selection to use replay context rather than only live io.coreReq bits, and enables bypassWrite for the data array.
pipeline/MSHR.scala removes the extra unmasked data.write initialization on MSHR allocation, leaving only mask initialization.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: In a banked shared-memory or scratchpad, one logical request may need to be replayed over multiple cycles when multiple lanes contend for the same bank. The replay cycles must continue using the original request metadata: whether the operation was a read or write, which bank/set address each remaining lane targets, and whether same-cycle write bypass is needed. If replay logic instead reuses current front-end signals or captures request state too early, only the first slice of the split transaction is handled correctly and later replayed slices can read from the wrong address, be classified as the wrong op type, or observe stale data.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A multi-lane shared-memory request is split because two or more lanes contend for the same bank, so the remaining lanes are replayed in a later cycle.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Make replay cycles depend on live input request signals or an early capture condition instead of the latched context of the accepted conflicting request.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: use live request bus during replay and capture on ready instead of fire
portability_notes: Apply this to any banked scratchpad or LDS design that serializes bank-conflicted lanes across multiple cycles.
The critical bug is loss of replay context, not any specific signal name.
If the design has separate replay bookkeeping for read/write classification, address selection, or bypass enable, any one of those can be corrupted to recreate the class of bug.
concrete_injection_steps: Identify the registers or replay state that hold the accepted request while leftover conflicted lanes are replayed.
Change the latch enable from actual request acceptance to a weaker condition such as ready, or bypass the latched state on replay cycles.
For replayed reads, source the SRAM read-valid or set-index path from the current input request instead of the stored replay request.
If the memory array has write-bypass or per-bank enable logic, disable the replay-aware gating so replayed accesses no longer see the original transaction context consistently.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: SharedMemory bank-conflict replay path and replay-aware SRAM access control
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The commit latches coreReq_st1 on fire instead of ready, exports bankConflict_isWrite from the arbiter, makes replayed read valid/setIdx use stored replay context, and adds bypassWrite plus replay-aware data-array enables.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Restore coreReq_st1 capture on io.coreReq.ready, remove bankConflict_isWrite-assisted replay classification, and drive replayed SRAM read control from live io.coreReq signals instead of stored conflict context.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: After a bank conflict splits a shared-memory access, later replayed slices can use the wrong op type or address context and may return stale or mis-associated data instead of correctly completing the original request.
evidence_for_injection: Before the fix, ShareMem.scala read requests during replay were still driven from io.coreReq.fire and io.coreReq.bits.setIdx.
The fix explicitly introduces a replay-aware read-valid signal and a Mux between current request context and stored coreReq_st1 context.
The arbiter now exports whether the conflicted request was a write, which only matters if replay classification was previously being lost.
notes: This commit also contains a second real DUT fix in pipeline/MSHR.scala, where an unmasked initialization write is removed to avoid corrupting masked SRAM writes.
For dataset portability, the shared-memory replay bug is the better primary injection target because it is more architecture-general and more directly observable.

zh.summary: 这是一个混合提交，其主要 DUT 修复是保持 shared memory bank-conflict replay 期间的正确请求上下文；同一提交还去掉了一个有害的 MSHR SRAM 无 mask 初始化写。
why_it_counts: shared memory 部分修复了 bank-conflicted 访问被拆成多周期后 replay 语义错误的问题。
补丁确保 replay 周期继续使用原始请求的类型与地址上下文，而不是误用当前前端信号。
同一提交还删除了会干扰带 mask 更新的 MSHR data SRAM 无 mask 写，这是另一个真实的 DUT 正确性修复。
disqualifiers: 该提交是混合的：还包含一个 assert 格式修复和参数调整，它们不属于主要缺陷机制。
evidence: ShareMem.scala 把 coreReq_st1 的锁存条件从 io.coreReq.ready 改为 io.coreReq.fire，说明 replay 上下文只应在请求真正被接受时保存。
BankConflictArbiter.scala 新增 bankConflict_isWrite 输出，ShareMem.scala 用它区分 replay 的读和写。
ShareMem.scala 让 SRAM 读使能与 set-index 选择在 replay 时使用保存的请求上下文，而不再只依赖实时 io.coreReq；同时给 data array 打开 bypassWrite。
pipeline/MSHR.scala 删除了 MSHR 分配时额外的无 mask data.write 初始化，只保留 mask 初始化。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 在带 bank 的 shared memory 或 scratchpad 中，一个逻辑请求在多个 lane 命中同一 bank 时，往往要被拆成多个周期 replay。后续 replay 周期必须继续使用原始请求的元数据：它是读还是写、剩余 lane 应该访问哪个 bank/set、以及是否需要同周期写旁路。如果 replay 逻辑改为读取当前前端信号，或者过早地保存请求状态，那么拆分事务通常只有第一拍是正确的，后续 replay 可能读错地址、把操作类型判错，或者读到陈旧数据。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: shared memory 的 bank-conflict replay 上下文保持
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 一个多 lane 的 shared memory 请求因两个或更多 lane 冲突同一 bank 而被拆分，剩余 lane 需要在下一周期 replay。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让 replay 周期依赖实时输入请求信号，或依赖过早的捕获条件，而不是依赖已被接受的冲突请求所保存的上下文。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: replay 期间读取实时请求总线，并把保存时机从 fire 改回 ready
portability_notes: 将该缺陷映射到任何会把 bank-conflicted lane 串行化到多个周期完成的 banked scratchpad 或 LDS 设计。
关键问题是 replay 上下文丢失，而不是具体信号名。
如果设计对 replay 的读写分类、地址选择或 bypass 使能有单独的保持逻辑，只要破坏其中之一，就能重现这一类缺陷。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到在 replay 剩余冲突 lane 时保存已接收请求的寄存器或 replay 状态。
把该状态的锁存条件从真正的请求接受改成更弱的 ready，或在 replay 周期直接绕过保存状态。
对 replay 的读操作，让 SRAM 读使能或 set-index 路径重新使用当前输入请求，而不是使用保存的 replay 请求。
如果存储阵列带有写旁路或逐 bank 使能控制，去掉 replay 感知的门控，使 replay 访问不再持续看到原始事务上下文。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: SharedMemory 的 bank-conflict replay 路径与 replay 感知的 SRAM 访问控制
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该提交把 coreReq_st1 的锁存从 ready 改为 fire，从 arbiter 导出 bankConflict_isWrite，让 replay 读的 valid/setIdx 使用保存的上下文，并增加 bypassWrite 与 replay 感知的 data-array 使能。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 恢复 coreReq_st1 在 io.coreReq.ready 时锁存，移除 bankConflict_isWrite 参与的 replay 分类，并让 replay 的 SRAM 读控制重新从实时 io.coreReq 信号取得。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 当 bank conflict 使 shared memory 访问被拆分时，后续 replay 片段可能使用错误的操作类型或地址上下文，从而返回陈旧数据或把数据关联到错误的原始请求。
evidence_for_injection: 修复前的 ShareMem.scala 在 replay 期间仍用 io.coreReq.fire 和 io.coreReq.bits.setIdx 驱动读路径。
补丁明确新增了 replay 感知的读有效信号，并通过 Mux 在当前请求上下文与保存的 coreReq_st1 上下文之间选择。
arbiter 现在额外导出冲突请求是否为写，这说明原先 replay 时读写分类可能丢失。
notes: 该提交还包含 pipeline/MSHR.scala 中的第二个真实 DUT 修复：删除无 mask 初始化写以避免破坏带 mask 的 SRAM 写。
从跨 DUT 的可复用性角度，shared memory replay 缺陷比 MSHR 初始化写更适合作为主要注入目标。
